timing_boundary: Antfly includes loopback HTTP transport and response serialization; PyTorch is an in-process public API call including preprocessing, model, decoding and formatting. Both exclude model load. This is a conservative HTTP-versus-in-process comparison, not a GPU-kernel-only benchmark.
gate: Every matched Antfly median must be strictly less than the PyTorch median.

http.timing_scope: Loopback HTTP request send through complete response read; separate TCP request per sample; excludes model load, validation, warmups, and client JSON decode/checks

correctness_scope: HTTP revalidated against every frozen oracle case. PyTorch benchmark receipts carry no per-trial numerical outputs; the original numerical qualification gates remain separate.
